# Digital Dreams

> Done-for-you SEO content, newsletters and social media content for small businesses. Written to rank on Google and to be understood and cited by AI assistants.

Digital Dreams plans, writes and repurposes content for small businesses on a month-to-month basis. Plans: Content Audit + 90-day plan ($299 one time), Starter ($497/month: 2 SEO blog posts, 1 newsletter, 8 social posts), Growth ($997/month: 4 SEO blog posts, 2 newsletters, 16 social posts, on-page SEO and AI-visibility work). Clients own all content once paid. No long contracts.
